name: CheckpointStore
logic_name: Program-bound durable checkpoint and evidence storage

test_list.description: Persist, drop the store, reopen it, and decode the exact checkpoint bytes.
Do not accept partial or malformed checkpoints after interruption.
Refuse a checkpoint whose bound immutable program identity differs.
Two independently opened handles concurrently save checkpoints and append CAS ledger nodes; reopening verifies all generations and evidence payloads are retained.
A content ID with no verified local CAS payload cannot be appended to the ledger.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Dedicated single-program research run directory under the trusted state root; a marker prevents reuse for another immutable program.

output_description: A concrete local durable adapter; checkpoint writes and evidence appends serialize across handles, retain monotone generations, and reopen through the binary codecs with verifiable evidence payloads.
